components.name: Sound Toggle
components.description: Global sound on/off pill in the masthead.

narrative.overview: Earth Records is cartography you can hear: precise NASA maps on near-black, a calm paper score of real measurements, and a vinyl record as the keepsake. Paper is for invitation and reading; deep is for looking and listening. The atlas must read before it impresses.
keyCharacteristics: Two surfaces, paper and deep, never mixed inside one panel.
Serif display for meaning, sans for doing, mono only for small reference labels.
Square-edged, ruled, editorial geometry; circles belong only to the record and the globe.
One clock: data motion follows the audio transport.
Every note has an origin you can inspect.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold lives on deep, copper lives on paper.

rules.name: The Readable-First Rule
rules.body: Anything a person must read to act is at least 14px, sentence case, DM Sans.

rules.name: The Object-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the record, sleeves and dialogs cast shadows.

dos: Do give every screen one obvious primary action and one lead sentence.
Do keep buttons and labels at 14px or more in sentence case.
Do keep sound opt-in and mirror everything audible on screen.
donts: Don't use house colors to encode data.
Don't put shadows on panels or controls.
Don't show a technical term without a plain explanation beside it.
